segments.he: אֵין הַגּוֹנֵב אַחַר הַגַּנָּב מְשַׁלֵּם תַּשְׁלוּמֵי כֶפֶל. אָמַר רַב: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא לִפְנֵי יֵאוּשׁ, אֲבָל לְאַחַר יֵאוּשׁ – קְנָאוֹ גַּנָּב רִאשׁוֹן, וְגַנָּב שֵׁנִי מְשַׁלֵּם תַּשְׁלוּמֵי כֶפֶל לְגַנָּב רִאשׁוֹן.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «One who steals» an item «after a thief» has already stolen it, i.e., one who steals a stolen item, «does not pay» the «double payment» to the thief or to the prior owner. Rather, he pays the principal amount alone. «Rav says: They taught» this halakha «only» in a case where the second thief stole from the first thief «before» the owner’s «despair» of recovering his item. «But» if the second thief stole it «after» the owner’s «despair, the first thief had acquired» the stolen item for himself as a result of the owner’s despair, «and the second thief pays» the «double payment to the first thief,» who at the time of the second theft was its legal owner.

moves.about: lemma: one who steals from a thief does not pay double

moves.cueHe: אמר רב: לא שנו אלא לפני יאוש
moves.about: the exemption applies only before despair; after despair the first thief acquired and the second pays him double
